name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow — project and task management platform (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run db --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
